request: the response delivery and shared frame behaviour

defects.description: Cancel removes the response slot although the transport still emits that request's response. The next queued callback receives the cancelled request's data and its own response is discarded.

trigger.input: Submit Read(a) and Read(b) with distinct callbacks; Cancel the first handle; Receive(secret-a); Receive(value-b).
trigger.expected: first callback not called; second callback receives value-b only
trigger.actual: first callback not called; second callback receives secret-a only

defects.why_missed: Ordered delivery and cancellation are exercised separately. The cancellation test has no following request, so discarding the slot cannot visibly misroute a response.

defects.description: The inspection flag reuses the legacy replication bit. An inspection frame routed to a generation-one handler silently causes replication rather than remaining read-only.

trigger.input: Create Data with value a=one and no replicas; pass Inspect(a) to Handle(1,frame,data); inspect data.Replicas[a].

defects.why_missed: The suite checks replication on generation one and inspection on generation two. It never dispatches a newly encoded inspection frame to a legacy handler using the shared wire format.
